title: UVP package manifest
description: Status: candidate (SPEC_UVP.md). The manifest of one Universal Package: the unit of shipping and dependency. A game base, a mod, a map and a campaign entry are all the same kind of object with a different `kind`. The world stays pure UVW; everything a shipped map carries besides terrain (map-local data overlays, triggers, code, media) lives in the package, mirroring how a real SC2Map archive and a Warzone .wz actually bundle content.

id.description: Stable package identity under UV foundation id rules: <namespace>/<name>. The namespace is a declared vendor or author namespace; core never special-cases one.

version.description: Semantic version of this package. Composition resolves dependency ranges against it.

kind.description: What role the package plays in composition. `map` REQUIRES exactly one uvw entry in contents. `library` carries shared UVB/UVS/UVD for other packages and no world. Immutable worldInstances selection is independent of kind. The kind name `universe` for a later connected-world package profile is RESERVED.

title.description: Presentation name. Optional: identity is `id`, never the title.

contents.description: Every artifact the package ships, each with the family it belongs to and its canonical hash. Paths are package-relative, forward-slash, no `..`. The hash is over the artifact's canonical form, so container packing (directory vs archive) never changes identity.

family.$comment: inline copy of foundation/uv-families.v1.schema.json#/$defs/contentFamily — verified equal by the uv-families suite

path.description: Package-relative, forward-slash: no drive letter, no leading slash, no `..` segment. `a..b.json` is a legal name; `/etc/x`, `C:/x` and `../x` are not.

hash.description: Algorithm-qualified canonical digest, e.g. `sha256:<64 hex>`. UVD/UVW use the domain-tagged RFC 8785/JCS envelope in SPEC_UVP.md; other families retain their own identity profiles.

layer.description: For uvd entries only: overlay rank inside this package when it ships more than one data document. Composition orders packages first, then this rank.

dependencies.description: Ordered composition inputs. Order inside one rank is explicit here, never derived from file systems or install order. A dependency cycle is a typed composition refusal.

rank.description: Composition layer this dependency joins: base < official < map < mod. Two writers of one field inside the same rank without an explicit order entry is a conflict, refused at composition.

order.description: Explicit order inside the rank; lower applies first. Required when more than one dependency shares a rank.

requires.description: Aggregated runtime requirements of everything inside: checked at composition BEFORE any content loads, so an unsatisfiable package refuses early and by name.

intrinsics.description: Every intrinsic id@version any shipped UVB/UVS references.

capabilities.description: Capability classes the package's code needs (UVE rights): a package that only reads may never mutate.

worldInstances.description: Immutable root selection of UVW instances. Dependency selections are presets and require an explicit root selection. An instance reuses captured UVW geometry with isolated entities, blockers and orders within the one runtime State. Local space IDs become <instance>/<space>; no unqualified fallback. Omitting this field retains the single-world legacy profile. Portals, frame motion and dynamic instance creation are not admitted by this profile.

instances.description: Unique instance IDs, sorted in ASCII order. The target must name exactly one UVW content entry in the reachable package closure. Repeated targets with different IDs are allowed.

id.description: Stable match-local identity; independent of array position and content digest.

path.description: Exact package-relative UVW content path, not a host URI. No empty, dot or parent segments.

runtimeRules.description: Immutable rules selected by the root before a match. Dependencies may supply presets, but a root must explicitly select a complete policy if any dependency declares one. Rules are bound into composition identity and cannot change through runtime commands. UVD remains the owner of game definitions; UVW remains the owner of topology. Omission preserves the legacy bounded runtime profile.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the immutable runtime policy. Unknown versions are refused before launch.

worldMutation.description: none freezes world topology while entities may still move; cell-blockers permits independent source-keyed closure of initially walkable traversal cells. Neither value admits terrain editing, digging, portals or moving frames.

namespaces.description: Vendor namespaces this package declares definitions in. A package writing into a namespace it does not declare and does not depend on is refused.

provenance.description: Optional lowering origin when an adapter produced this package from native game content: the LoweringReceipt digest chain.
